freeze_scope: Existing reference, grouping and main settings pinned; prospective recovery/extension decisions sealed now. Not retroactive preregistration.
grouping_policy: Keep all preselected 20 companies × 3 questions. No result-based exclusions or additions. Company-cluster inference; shared laws do not create independent samples.
reference_semantics: Human-adjudicated pages and answer points; page overlap and citation ID existence are not semantic labels. Alternative verified evidence allowed.
historical_exposure: Original test outputs and some reference material have already been seen. Newly selected extension contrasts and compact rubric are exploratory.

main.attempt_policy: One separately recorded exact-input retry for each primary failed unit. Keep primary outcomes. First valid output by attempt order forms a separately labeled recovered analysis view.
main.stop_policy: Stop new dispatch immediately on quota exhaustion; drain in-flight calls. Other rate limits also stop this recovery rather than loop. Three non-quota consecutive failures or integrity violation stop dispatch.

monetary_budget.authority: User explicitly authorized no upper limit and direct generation on 2026-10-20; retained across turns.
monetary_budget.cost_policy: Retain observed tokens and actual bills if available; do not infer price/currency cost from alias or reference tokenizer.

retrieval.embedding_query_prompt:
Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:

reranker.instruction: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query

ablations.invariants: Same question inventory, source index and exclusion policy, role quota, reference token ceiling and generation settings. Existing G2/G3 is the role-constraint contrast.
ablations.devices: CUDA for any neural embedding/reranking, no CPU neural fallback; saved vectors reused.

robustness.transformation: Remove the indicated role from saved G3 dual context, preserve remaining original source texts/IDs, no replacement retrieval or gold-guided selection.
robustness.clean_control: Reuse exact-input main G3 answer with full attempt provenance. Perturbed cases are paired variants, not additional independent questions.

model_comparison.same_family_caveat: Two Kimi versions are not different model families. A different family requires an available endpoint/model and a separately sealed compatible settings record before calls.

stage_gates: Validate freeze and source bindings, then recover main failed units only.
Complete main availability audit before ablation and robustness execution.
Do not launch secondary model until exact callable identifier and parameter record are sealed.
No quality statistics, effect charts or empirical paper conclusions until actual output review judgments exist.

output_review.workflow: One row per actual answer, four scores; reconcile only disagreements; never use self-reported model labels as human review.

analysis.unknown_policy: U remains unknown; report judged coverage and bounds; never impute zero.
analysis.failures: Report first-attempt 147/180 separately from recovered availability and all extra calls. No silent removal of incomplete questions.
analysis.multiple_testing: Holm across explicitly reported confirmatory tests if later feasible; new extensions remain exploratory.
analysis.score: Compact total 0–8 only with four known scores; label answer quality, not company governance.
